top_signals.title: UMNO Hopeful Malaysia Ex-PM Najib Will Secure Royal Pardon
top_signals.summary: Malaysia’s former ruling party United Malays National Organisation is hopeful of a positive outcome from former Prime Minister Najib Razak’s latest bid for a royal pardon, party president Ahmad Zahid Hamidi said.
top_signals.why_it_matters: AI and semiconductor developments impacting technology leadership and capex cycles.
